what: lessonctl resume printed 'NEXT: S2 boxes' while 12 of 13 section files were still missing (stage field was S1).
why: NEXT is the work order any agent follows; a wrong NEXT wastes a resume cycle or causes stage-skipping.
fix: resume now derives NEXT from per-section file presence: missing files => finish them at the current stage; only a complete stage advances.
root_cause: stage label used as the sole NEXT signal; per-section reality ignored.

what: course.yaml box_allowlist omitted quick-check although quick_checks is a core feature and the s01 format-of-record uses :::quick-check.
why: allowlist is the contract for which boxes renderers must support; a missing entry risks a renderer dropping the practice layer.
root_cause: allowlist seeded before S3 practice grammar was finalized.

what: course.yaml spine titles for u1:c02 and u2:c16 are corrupted by unquoted YAML titles containing commas: 'title: Elements' + stray key 'compounds and mixtures: null' (and 'Acids' + 'alkalis and titrations: null'). The scaffold then propagated the broken title into the fresh lesson.yaml.
why: YAML parses a comma inside an unquoted scalar fine, but the entry got split at authoring time — likely a table/TSV-to-YAML conversion dropped a comma. Two chapters hit = systematic, not a one-off typo.
fix: Both titles quoted and restored in this PR: c02 'Elements, compounds and mixtures' (matches section_map chapter_title + printed heading), c16 'Acids, alkalis and titrations' (matches slug acids-alkalis-titrations).
root_cause: course.yaml spine was generated from a tabular source without quoting title strings.
system_change: rule added: every string in course.yaml spine that may contain a comma/colon is quoted; course.yaml validated with yaml.safe_load before commit (this session's edit passed). Lint currently reads lesson.yaml only — noted as potential lint-gap if scaffold is used unattended again.
